description: Candidate minimizes the failure, deflects blame to circumstances or teammates, no clear lesson, and no stated behavior change afterward.

inputs.[PASTE BEHAVIORAL QUESTION]: Tell me about a time you failed.
inputs.[PASTE YOUR ANSWER]: Well, so I was working on this project at DataScale Inc. and we had some issues with the deployment pipeline. It turned out that one of my teammates didn't follow the standard procedure for setting up the environment. I mean, it's not like it's a big deal or anything, but yeah... We got it fixed eventually.
inputs.[PASTE ROLE TITLE, KEY REQUIREMENTS, OR: As a Senior Software Engineer at DataScale Inc., you will be responsible for leading cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable software systems. You will be expected to drive technical vision, execute on complex projects, and mentor junior engineers.

evalCriteria: Should detect that the candidate minimizes the failure
Should flag that the candidate deflects blame to circumstances or teammates
Should rate 'no clear lesson' as weak or missing
Should identify that the candidate does not state a behavior change afterward
Should ask evidence recovery questions about what the candidate learned from the experience
